comment: Which Assets-board scope toggle each backend AssetSource falls under. Asserted by tests/unit/test_asset_board_scopes.py (every flow_sdk AssetSource has a row, and a real on-disk world yields each source) and ui/tests/unit/asset-manager-board.test.tsx (assetBoardScope agrees row by row). A new AssetSource fails the Python side until it is given a scope here, and then the UI side until board-scope.ts maps it.
